summary.zh: 先算样本量再定指标，避免过早下结论
summary.en: Size the test and define metric and stop rules up front

description.zh: 在规划 A/B、分流或多变量实验之前，先明确假设、核心指标和停止规则，并按预期提升幅度估算所需样本量。适合上线前判断实验是否值得做，以及结果出来后确认是否显著。
description.en: Plans A/B, split or multivariate tests: states the hypothesis, primary metric and stop rule, then sizes the sample for the expected lift. Use it before launching a test or to judge whether results are significant.
